vulnerability.title: Django FileBasedCache creates intermediate cache directories with the process umask instead of 0o077 on Python 3.7+
vulnerability.category_l2: permission escalation in intermediate-level directories of the file system cache

fixed_releases.verified_content: At tag 3.0.10 (a208020e), filebased.py blob 64cc175b wraps os.makedirs in os.umask(0o077); fix cdb367c9 is an ancestor of the tag and absent from 3.0.9.
At tag 2.2.16 (bf07047f), filebased.py blob 012b54e8 contains the umask wrapper; fix a3aebfdc is an ancestor of the tag.
At tag 3.1.1 (f33c2528), filebased.py blob 10779c55 contains the umask wrapper; fix 2b099caa is an ancestor of the tag.

vulnerability.vulnerable_commit_basis: tag 3.0.2 points directly at a3697439; the 3.0.9 filebased.py blob is byte-identical to 3.0.2 and to the 3.0.x fix parent 08892bff, while the 3.0.10 blob differs, so 3.0.2 carries the unfixed _createdir implementation

critical_operation.description: FileBasedCache._createdir invokes os.makedirs(self._dir, 0o700, exist_ok=True) without controlling the process umask. On Python 3.7+ os.makedirs applies the mode argument only to the leaf directory; intermediate-level directories are created with 0o777 masked by the ambient umask, typically 0o755, so they are group- and world-readable and traversable while the intended cache directory mode is 0o700. Cache entries are stored as files under self._dir, so a local attacker able to traverse the intermediate directories can reach the cache tree and read cached values whose filenames are predictable md5 digests. The 3.0.10/2.2.16/3.1.1 fix sets the umask to 0o077 around os.makedirs so every created directory receives 0o700.

entry_point.description: The first cache write or read triggers directory creation for the configured LOCATION, including any missing parent directories.

trace.description: _createdir is the only place that creates the cache directory tree
os.makedirs receives 0o700 as the leaf mode but no umask guard, so intermediate directories use the ambient umask
cache entries are written as files beneath the created directory

source_crosscheck.notes: The Django announcement, NVD and OSV/GHSA agree on the three affected ranges, the fixed releases 2.2.16/3.0.10/3.1.1 and the root cause in intermediate cache-directory permissions. The MITRE CNA record is a placeholder. NVD assigns CWE-276 and CVSS 3.1 7.5 HIGH. Upstream blob identity ties 3.0.2 and 3.0.9 to the fix parent content. The three backport commits cite a master commit f56b5797 that is not reachable in the public repository; the advisory-listed master changeset 1853724a was verified instead and first appears in tag 3.2a1. The 24584 fixes are chained on the 24583 fixes: cdb367c9 parent 08892bff, a3aebfdc parent 375657a7, 2b099caa parent 934430d2, 1853724a parent 8d727157.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read FileBasedCache._createdir at 3.0.2 and confirm the unguarded makedirs mode and the Python 3.7+ intermediate-directory behaviour.
An independent reviewer must confirm cdb367c9 is absent from 3.0.2 and 3.0.9 and an ancestor of 3.0.10, and that 3.0.10 wraps makedirs in umask(0o077).
An independent reviewer must confirm the 2.2.16 and 3.1.1 fixes and the three release boundaries against a second source family.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No cache operation, filesystem permission experiment or Django test suite was executed; the finding is static.
The Python 3.7+ os.makedirs intermediate-directory behaviour is taken from the advisory and the fixed comment; it was not reproduced locally.
The impact requires a local attacker or co-tenant able to traverse the intermediate directories; remote exploitation is not claimed.
The MITRE CVE v5 CNA record is a placeholder (vendor/product/version n/a, problemType n/a, no CVSS).
NVD also carries a CVSS 2.0 metric of 5.0; the canonical score follows the NVD primary CVSS 3.1 metric.
OSV carries a CVSS 4.0 vector (VC:N/VI:L/VA:N) alongside the CVSS 3.1 vector (C:H/I:N/A:N); the integrity and confidentiality treatments differ between versions and were not reconciled.

The three backport commits state "Backport of f56b5797... from master", but that object is not reachable in the public django/django clone and the advisory lists 1853724a as the master changeset. The master-side change was verified through 1853724a, which first appears in tag 3.2a1.
No downstream distribution backport was verified; only upstream tags and commits are used.
The snapshot inventory status is NEEDS_REVIEW with 67 ambiguous files, not a clean PASS.
open_questions: Whether typical deployments place LOCATION under a group-accessible parent was not surveyed.
The exact CPython change that made os.makedirs stop applying mode to intermediate directories was not traced.
The sibling CVE-2020-24583 (upload/collectstatic directory permissions) is recorded as a separate candidate and is not covered here.
